NORTHWIND LOGISTICS — REMOTE WORK POLICY (2026 EDITION)

1. Scope
This policy applies to all permanent employees of Northwind Logistics after their probationary period. Contractors and agency staff are covered by a separate agreement.

2. Working location
Employees may work remotely up to three days per week with written approval from their line manager. Remote days must be recorded in the scheduling system before 10:00 on the day they are taken. The office remains open from 08:00 to 18:00 on weekdays.

3. Eligibility
The remote working pilot begins on 1 March 2026 and runs for twelve months. Staff who joined before 1 January 2026 are eligible immediately; later joiners become eligible after six months of service.
